title: A System Dynamics Analysis of National R&D Performance Measurement System in Korea
reasoning: The paper discusses bias and fairness in the R&D performance measurement and peer review process, which relates to the ethical conduct of an evaluation system. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethical frameworks as its primary subject. The focus is on the administrative and systemic aspects of fair evaluation rather than a philosophical or comparative study of ethical systems or beliefs.
